responsibility: Manages the splay-tree-backed constructor objects used to represent array and structure initializers. It allocates, copies, inserts, appends, removes, iterates, and looks up gfc_constructor nodes by offset while preserving repeat counts and nested expression trees for use in DATA handling, constant folding, and lowering.
same_name_distinction: Provides the concrete splay-tree implementation of constructor storage and traversal, including allocation, copying, insertion, lookup, iteration, and removal of gfc_constructor nodes. Unlike gcc/fortran/constructor.h, it realizes the constructor container mechanics instead of just declaring them.
